# Rivan Studio

> Rivan Studio is a small studio in Norway that makes short vertical video ads for brands, starring its own fictional AI characters. Every video is labelled as AI-generated.

## Offer
- Pilot: one 10–20 second vertical (9:16) video, NOK 990 excl. VAT.
- Three videos: NOK 2,490 excl. VAT.
- Idea and first frame the same day; finished video within 48 hours of approval; one round of changes included.
- Built from the brand's product photos; nothing to ship.
- Use in organic and paid social media for 3 months; longer on request.
- Characters never claim to have used, tested or recommended a product.

## Characters
- Elise: home editor (rugs, lighting, textiles, storage).
- Orin: silent deadpan comedy (snacks, drinks, gadgets, apps).
- Ada: calm dawn routines (coffee, activewear, bags, skincare).
- Vera: Last Light Swim Club (swimwear, sunglasses, sun care, linen).

## Contact
